friendly_name: troupe configuration: keep shared includes shared
purpose_context: Included YAML files are shared between projects. Step 5 (CR-A) introduces mapping-form includes ($ref plus override keys, deep-merged) and changes set so that new keys under an included section become overrides in the including file, while existing settings are still changed where they live.
purpose_tldr: Adding a new setting under an included section writes an override in the including file instead of modifying the shared include.
